_readme: One example of every entity BopOp v1 holds, split the way v2 should store it:
project knowledge (what the farm IS) vs progress (what we DID to it).
People are anonymised. Shapes and field names are drawn from the v1 record;
they are here to show MEANING, not to be copied as a v2 schema.
Dates are ISO-8601 UTC. In v2 every one of them is a SERVER timestamp.

foundation.label: G05
foundation._note: label is the human key AND the key the v1 merge matched on. Keep it stable.

substation.label: OSS
substation._note: Not one of the 62. Has a free-text sheet instead of a task dial (PR #58).

string._note: 8 strings, each walking outward from the substation. The whole layout is ONE drawing: it travels as a block, last editor wins (decision 2026-08-01, PR #65).

accessRules.text:
SRCC - String / cable circuit under restricted access.
No intrusive work on the cable circuit without a valid permit.
accessRules._note: Dated since PR #54: before that the merge kept the LONGER text and a shortened rule could never stick.

_note: id is derived from the English name (decision 2026-08-01) so two devices
configured separately talk about the same task. Tiers: centre (max 8),
firstRing (16), secondRing (32). order IS the slice order on the dial.
In v1 the name exists in English only - PR #60 translated the page chrome,
never the content. v2 must carry both languages on the record.

inspectionType._note: Repeatable: counted as dated occurrences, never ticked.

communication.en: Report any damaged earthing strap to the team leader before starting.
communication.fr: Signaler toute tresse de terre endommagee au chef d'equipe avant de commencer.

method.en: 1. Clean the cable. 2. Apply ScotchKoat. 3. Photograph before and after.
method.fr: 1. Nettoyer le cable. 2. Appliquer le ScotchKoat. 3. Photographier avant et apres.

_note: Each section is dated on its own (PR #54). The consumables list travels as
a BLOCK, last editor wins - a union by name cannot say 'remove this' (PR #48).
minutes x people = the work-hours every percentage is built on (PR #50).
An inspection has ONE free-text box instead of these sections, and no time (PR #55).
Four states: notDone | inProgress | partiallyDone | done (PR #56).
partiallyDone counts half toward work-hours; inProgress counts ZERO and
stays in 'what is left'; an untimed task is excluded from BOTH sides.
changedAt is separate from at, and is what the merge used: 'not done' has
no stamp of its own, so unticking had nothing to travel with (PR #34).
In v2 this should be an EVENT, not a field - see HANDOVER 8.2.

taskComment.text: Strap replaced, photo sent to the team leader.

inspectionOccurrence._note: A union: two technicians each recording one offline must both count. A removed occurrence is remembered separately (PR #34).

foundationNote.text: Ladder bracket loose on the lower platform.

punchItem.text: G05 - handrail bolt missing, north side
punchItem._note: Always attached to a foundation. Adding one 'on the fly' was tried and cancelled (PR #57).

permit._note: kind is BOP | SAP | CTV. Closing is a decision that always beats a concurrent edit.

toolboxTalk.text: Working at height on the lower platform. Three points of contact.
toolboxTalk._note: One per day, the day IS the id, so two devices writing the same day land on the same record. Archiving is automatic (PR #39).

recapSent.text: G05 - ScotchKoat done, Survey In/Out done. Punch: handrail bolt missing north side.
recapSent._note: Kept verbatim: this is what actually went out to the crew channel.

activityEntry.detail: G05 - ScotchKoat on earthing cable - done
activityEntry._note: Two streams, shown as two tabs: work on site, and changes to the app's own settings (PR #59). Capped at 800 entries / 180 days in v1.

readMark._note: Clears once that person has had the changed section in view (half visible, 0.75 s) - PR #53. See open question Q4.

_note: Clearing the farm is a DATE, not a deletion (PR #32): a union cannot say
'this was erased' and the other phone put everything back.
decidedAt was added in PR #63 because two wipe dates merged with max() made
a wipe impossible to undo - the decision has to travel, not just its effect.
Wipes ticks, comments, inspections, notes and blocking points on all 62.
Leaves tasks, method statements, crew and cables untouched.

_notImported: map notes (annotations) - editor removed in PR #68; to verify any exist
multi-project machinery - one farm, one project (open question Q6)
day plan - per-device in v1, never synced
